title: Whoosh
author: Becky Hill
notes: The Caller's Box 10875, permission: full. M6's own dance: the grand right and left runs three neighbours out along the line and the allemandes bring you back, so every call names the dancer it wants by a relation rather than by a place in a minor set. The dance the end-of-set rule was written for: at four couples nobody's N3 exists at all, so its A1 is three pull-bys of which most dancers make one or two, and the end-effects table names which pass leaves whom out. Green at 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 couples since M7b - closure 0.0000 px, reach 0.0000 px, collision 8.500 px.
